category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Privacy procedures are included in human resources practices (e.g., deprovisioning, personnel screening).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PS-3 (Personnel Screening), PS-4 (Personnel Termination), PS-5 (Personnel Transfer)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.6.1 (Screening), A.6.5 (Termination or change of employment responsibilities)
implementation_examples: Integrate privacy procedures into HR practices: pre-hire screening, onboarding acknowledgement of privacy roles, in-role refresher training, off-boarding deprovisioning (access revocation, asset return)
Coordinate with line managers and system owners to action the lifecycle
Capture evidence of completion for accountability
assessment_objectives: Determine whether privacy procedures are integrated into HR lifecycle practices
Determine whether access revocation is timely on termination
Determine whether acknowledgements and training records are captured
Determine whether HR and IT coordinate on the privacy lifecycle
